(ta)༄༅/ /'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti pra dze

tei:div.tei:p: (ta)༄༅// 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti pra dze bhyaḥ bla ma mchog dang gshin rje'i gshed// dbyer med zhabs la gus btud nas// dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo yi// rjes gnang bya tshul bshad par bya// 'dir 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor rgyal mo'i rjes gnang bya tshul la/ sbyor ba rten dang mchod pa bsham pa/ dngos gzhi bdag mdun slob ma'i bya ba/ rjes cho ga'i mjug bsdu ba gsum las/ dang po ni slob dpon nyid kyis rjes su gnang ba man ngag dang bcas pa legs par thob nas/ yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su stegs ji ltar rigs pa'i steng maṇḍal la chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag mu khyud ljang gu/ de'i mthar zlum pos bskor ba'i zla gam gsum sngon po bcad dmar po byas pa rdul tshon gyis bris pa'am ras la bris pa bsham/ de'i steng du mañdzi'i khar gtor ma gru gsum che ba gcig la chung ba bzhis bskor ba rtsi dmar po byugs shing mar rgyan gyis spras pa/ mda' la dar nag btags pa lha mo'i tsa ka li rab gnas can btsugs la mdun du 'bul gtor de 'dra ba chung ba zhig dang*/ g.yas su sman phud/ g.yon du rakta/ de rnams kyi mdun du mchod yon sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod lnga sbreng tshar du bsham/ seng ldeng gi be con dang*/ thod pa bdud rtsi cung zad blugs pa gtor ma'i g.yas g.yon gang bder bzhag rang gi mdun du nang mchod bu ram dang bdud rtsi ril bu btab pa slob ma du yod ldangs pa dang*/ rdor dril/ ḍa ma ru/ me tog gi snod rnams sta gon bya ba sngon 'gro'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed slob ma'i bya ba'o// dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams hrīḥṣṭīḥs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/

me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ badzra arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dya/ shabda āḥhūm̐/ ḍa dril dkrol/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba buddha kṣe ṭa pra tsa li te pradzñā pā ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha we badzra dharma hṛ da ya/ santo ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ bdag dang 'gro ba sogs skyabs 'gro bzhi skor tshar bdun sogs/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las padma nyi ma ma he'i gdan gyi steng du rang skad cig gis zhe sdang gshin rje'i gshed sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod dbyug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar bsnams pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan zhing rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ma he dmar po'i steng na g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas gshin rje'i gshed la sangs rgyas dang byang sems kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan/

thugs kar hūm̐ gi mthar sngags phreng gis bskor bar gyur/ oṃ hrīḥṣṭīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus dang*/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes brjod/ de nas gnyis pa mdun bskyed ni/ hṝḥṣṭīs bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga dang dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag las grub pa'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ zhes brjod pas stong par bsam/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āḥzhes brjod pas thod pa'i snod du bsam/ gnyis ka bstan te/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag las grub pa'i gtor mar bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te/ ha ho hrīḥzhes brjod pas 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i gur khang me ri rab tu 'bar ba'i nang du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi la sogs pa drag po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su/ khrag zhag 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil du/ kṣa las be con kṣas mtshan pa las/ dpal ldan lha mo re wa tī dmag zor rgyal mo dre'u rta la zhon pa/ sku mdog thing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing mi ro rengs pa khar bcug pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ smin ma'i dbus su khro gnyer rab tu bsdus pa/ dbu skra kham pa gyen du brdzes pa las me lce dang me stag du ma 'phro ba/ snyan g.yas pa la dug sbrul/ g.yon pa la seng ges brgyan pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan zhing*/

rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcus do shal byas pa/ sku la khrag gi thig le/ zhag gi zo ris thal chen gyi tshom bu bkod pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi cod pan dang lhab lhub kyis bklubs pa/ zhing chen gyi g.yang gzhi dang ri ldes stod g.yogs pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ sbrul gyi ska rags dang do shal sogs dpal gyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i tsandan gyi be con nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon yungs kar dang khrag gis gang ba'i nal thod thugs kar 'dzin pa/ sga'i snga shal nad kyi rkyal pa/ btsan gyi byang dmar/ shwa rde'u dkar nag 'phyang ba/ phyi sha la tshon gyi gru gu btags shing*/ bdud kyi khram shing rked la gzer ba/ lte ba'i thad nas nyi ma dang*/ spyi gtsug nas zla ba 'char ba/ dbu steng du rma bya'i gdugs phub pa/ 'khor bdud phrug gi tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ mig rtsa dmar zhing rab tu rngam pa'i cha lugs can/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yon na yungs kar dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ g.yas mtshon cha sna tshogs pa bsnams pa dpag tu med pas bskor ba/ de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ byang shar mtsho mu le ding nas dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing*/ lha mo'i sgos kyi spos tshil chen sha chen gu gul cong zhi/ mngal khrag rnams bsres pa'i bdug spos yod na bsregs/ ma 'byor na'ang gu gul rkyang pa bsreg cing dril bu gsil/ dril bu ma 'byor na ma mo spyi'i dam rgya mgo thod kyi phyag rgya bcas la mdzub mo gnyis g.yab cing*/ bhyoḥchos 'khor yongs kyi srung ma re wa tī// sngon tshe rgyal ba'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin// bstan pa bsrung dang sgrub la phan gdags phyir// byang shar mtshams nas spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol// bhyoḥrakmo bhyoḥ rakmo bhyoḥbhyoḥ

rakmo thun bhyoḥ ra kmo kha la rag chen mo rakmo a bya ta bya thun bhyoḥru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ shrī ye de wī kā li kā li ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ ā karṣa ya e hye hi ṭakki dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mdun du ye shes pa spyan drangs/ bhyoḥnag mo gdug can dregs pa can// kun tu khyab pa'i gzugs ston ma// nag mo gtso mo dre'u rta bcibs// 'dir byon dre'u rta'i gdan la bzhugs// rakmo sogs kyi rjes su dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma ya st+waṃ tiṣṭhantu dṛ shya hoḥ padma ka ma lā ya st+waṃ/ zhes pas ye shes pa dam tshig pa la bstim/ de nas rang yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas lha mo la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ bhyoḥza byed nag mo mche ba can// dgod byed ha ha nag mo khyod// gsod la dga' bar byed pa mor// bdag ni brda yis phyag bgyid do// rakmo sogs kyi rjes su/ a ti pu hoḥ zhes brjod cing thal mo sbyar nas lha mo la phyag btsal bar mos la mgo dud tsam byas/ pra tītstsha hoḥzhes brjod pas lha mos bdag la gus pas phyag 'tshal bar bsam/ slar yang thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha gshin rje'i gshed rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badzra sa mā dzaḥ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gshin rje'i gshed kyis dbur brgyan/ de nas bdud rtsi sman phud nas phul bar bsam/ nang mchod nas mtheb srin gyis gtor la/ phra mo sbom po las byung ba'i// bdud rtsis bran pa dza gad 'di// dmag zor rgyal mo la 'bul gyis// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// rakmo sogs kyi rjes su/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ yang rakta nas phul bar bsam/ nang mchod nas mtheb srin gyis gtor la/ chu dang ma 'dres dwangs ma'i khrag /dwangs ma yi ni khrag chen po// dmag zor rgyal mo la 'bul gyis// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// rakmo sogs kyi rjes su/

ma hā rakta kha kha khā hi khā hi zhes brjod/ 'khu ldog mi 'ong zhing dam tshig bsre ba'i phyir/ rang yi dam gyi lha dang lha mo snyoms par zhugs pa las byung ba'i byang sems dkar dmar sbyor mtshams nas blangs te lha mo mchod cing dam tshig bsres par bsams la nang mchod nas blangs te/ rang gi lce thog tu bzhag cing lha mo'i sngags la phul bar bsam zhing 'bru gsum brjod la gtor/ de nas gtor ma phul ba ni/ lha mo 'khor bcas kyi ljags las 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma la zug pas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ pad skor dang bcas pas rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ sha khrag bdud rtsi lnga sbyar ba// 'bru sna lnga sbyar gtor ma 'di// dmag zor rgyal mo la 'bul gyis// bstan pa bsrung phyir bzhes su gsol// rakmo sogs kyi rjes su/ oṃ shrī ye de wī ma hā kā li de wī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa'i gtor sngags lan gsum mam lnga bdun la sogs pas phul/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ bdud rtsi gtor zhing 'bru gsum brjod pas nang mchod phul la/ dpal ldan lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bstan pa dang sems can la 'tshe ba/ rnal 'byor pa chos bsgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad tshar gcod cing zhi ba dang*/ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod dbang thang rigs rgyud la sogs pa thams cad rgyas pa dang*/ 'gro ba ma lus pa dbang du 'du zhing legs pa'i yon tan mtha' dag gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod/ bdag cag dus 'dir tshe ring zhing*// bu dang tsha bo rgyas pa dang*// 'khor dang longs spyod rab 'phel zhing*// bsam don chos bzhin 'grub par mdzod// yid la brnag pa'i dgra dang bgegs// bdud dang bar chad rnam mang po// thams cad gtan nas brlag pa dang*// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces gsol ba gdab cing phrin las bcol/

de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas lha mo'i thugs rgyud bskul bas bka' bsgo ba nyan cing phrin las thogs med du sgrub par bsams la/ bhyoḥrakmo bhyoḥ rakmo bhyoḥbhyoḥ rakmo thun bhyoḥ rakmo kha la rakṣanmo/ rakmo a bya ta bya thun bhyoḥ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥhūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzlas/ mthar/ arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod phul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bhyoḥ bcom ldan gshin rje'i gshed pa'i spyan snga ru// sangs rgyas bstan pa srung bar khas blangs ma// drel rta la zhon rngams zhing shin tu brjid// srid pa'i rgyal mo chen mo khyed la bstod// kye kye ma gcig gnyen gyi re wā tī// khyod la dam rdzas mchod gtor 'di 'bul bas// bdag cag 'khor bcas srung zhing skyong ba dang*// 'dod don ma lus sgrub mdzad khyed la bstod// nad dang gnod pa thams cad rab zhi zhing*// tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod rgyas mdzad cing*// skye 'gro dbang sdud mngon spyod drag po yis// dgra bgegs rtsad nas tshar gcod ma la bstod// ces pas bstod cing*/ de rnams slob dpon gyi bya ba'o// gsum pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ thog mar slob dpon gyis bgegs bskrad pa'i phyir rdor dril gsor dkrol bya/ yungs kar gyis brab cing hrīḥṣṭīḥbazlas/ slob ma rnams gral la 'khod/ khrus byas me tog bkye bsdu grub nas/ 'o nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang bar bgyi'o snyam pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la gsan bya chos kyi ngo bo ni ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ rin chen chos kyang dkon la rtag tu 'tshe ba'ang mang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar/

rang re snyigs mar spyod pa'i 'gro ba rnams la chos spyod pa'i gang zag dkon zhing re re tsam byung ba la yang bar chad kyi rigs shin tu mang bas de zlog pa'i thabs la chos skyong ba'i srung ma mang du gsungs pa'i nang nas 'dir skabs su babs pa dpal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma yin/ de yang sngon gyi bstan bcos 'chi med mdzod sogs na lha mo dbu ma dang gcig par bshad nas ming gi rnam grangs dgu bcu tsam gsungs shing*/ bya rgyud rig pa mchog gi rgyud las/ phyag na rdo rjes nam gru'i rigs la bstod nas ston pas dkyil 'khor du bcug nas dbang bskur/ gsang sngags spyi'i srung mar bskos shing bla med kyi rgyud rdo rje gdan bzhi sogs nas de wī ko ṭar gnas nas zhing skyong ma mo thams cad kyi gtso mo mdzad par bshad/ de lta bu'i srung ma khyad par can 'di nyid ni bla ma ā tsarya dmar po'am paṇḍi ta gsang ba shes rab tu grags pas spyan drangs shing*/ lce 'byung gnas bzang po sogs nas rim par brgyud de/ bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa'i dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes su gnang ba sgrub par byed pa la sngon 'gro slob dpon gyis bya bar 'os pa thams cad legs par grub nas khyed rang rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la/ slob dpon la gshin rje'i gshed dang tha mi dad par mos nas rjes su gnang ba zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal phul nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// gtso bo lha mor bcas pa yi// sku gsung thugs la skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang gi// dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol// lan gsum/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas rgyud dag pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/

mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo sogs kyi spyan sngar khyed rang rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyid snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// sogs lan gsum/ de ltar rgyud dag par byas nas thog mar sku'i rjes gnang gi slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje can// dpa' bo chen po dgongs su gsol// shākya seng ge'i bstan pa la// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do// gtso bo ston pa'i bka' srung gis// 'dren pa'i bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// sems can kun la sman slad du// ma mo drag mo la sogs pa'i// mthu dang dngos grub 'byung ba'i rgyu// dam tshig can de bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ slob dpon la gshin rje gshed dngos yin snyam pa'i gus 'dud drag po byas pas/ slob dpon gyis thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros khyed rang rnams kyi lus la phog nas stong par gyur/ de'i ngang nas rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i zhes pa nas klong dkyil du/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid kṣaḥlas sogs/ thugs kar hūm̐/ hūm̐ gi steng du bhyoḥyig mthing nag re re yod pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slar yang slob dpon mdun bskyed dang bcas pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ khyed rang rnams kyi thugs ka'i bhyoḥyig las 'od zer 'phros pas byang shar mtsho mu le ding nas dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo'i sku dpag tu med pa kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo la sogs pa'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas sib sib thim pas lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi zhing lha mo'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/

ces brjod/ ḍa dril sogs rol mo'i sgra dang gu gul gyis bdug hrīḥṣṭīḥdang*/ bhyoḥrakmo sogs kyi mthar ā be sha ya āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥbatags pa drag tu brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyis lha mo'i phyag mtshan be con dang thod pa khyed rang rnams kyi lag pa gnyis su byin pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bhyoḥrakmo sogs brjod cing gtad/ de nas gtor ma lha mor gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi dbu thog tu bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas// sku yi phrin las lhun grub nas// dam can 'du zhing 'khor ba dang*// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang thob shog /bhyoḥrakmo sogs brjod/ gtor ma bzhag dril bu gsil me tog gtor/ sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru// chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la// bar chad srung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /de rnams kyis lha mo'i sku'i rjes gnang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag dpal ldan lha mo khyed rang rnams kyi lus dang grib ma ltar 'grogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de sku'i rjes gnang yin/ gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gong gi he ru ka dpal sogs/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas slob dpon gyis gtor ma lha mor gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas// gsung gi phrin las lhun grub nas// dam can= dgra bgegs= bhyoḥrakmo sogs brjod/ gtor ma bzhag sngags brjod cing bdud rtsi sbyin/ sngon tshe bcom ldan sogs shis pa brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi zhal nas sngags phreng byung*/ khyed rang rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ snying ga'i bhyoḥyig la thim pas gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs par mos nas sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum gyi bar du mdzod/

bhyoḥrakmo sogs lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byas pas lha mo'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi dri ma dag lha mos khyed rang rnams kyis bka' bsgo ba bzhin bsgrubs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de gsung gi rjes gnang yin/ thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ he ru ka dpal sogs/ yang gtor ma lha mor gsal ba nyid khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag nas byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas// thugs kyi phrin las lhun grub nas// dam can 'du zhing 'khor ba dang*// dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dbang thob shog /bhyoḥrakmo sogs brjod/ gong ltar bdud rtsi sbyin/ bkra shis brjod/ des lha mo'i thugs kyi rjes gnang thob/ sems kyi dri ma dag khyed rang rnams kyi sems dang lha mo'i thugs gnyis su med par gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de thugs kyi rjes gnang yin/ phrin las gtor mas bka' bsgo ba'i slad du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ he ru ka dpal sogs/ de ltar gsol ba btab nas dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor ma 'di nyid lha mor gsal ba khyed rang rnams kyi dbu thog tu bzhag nas bka' bsgo ba phul ba'i mos pa mdzod/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje/ paṇḍi ta shes rab gsal ba/ lce 'byung gnas bzang po/ gnubs rgyal ba ye shes/ zhang shes rab bla ma/ zhang

saṃ gha padma bha dra/ zhang dpal chen 'od/ zhang rdo rje rtse mo/ zhang nyi ma grags 'od/ zhang rin chen rnam rgyal/ bsam gling pa sangs rgyas 'byung ba/ 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen/ byang sems rin chen blo gros mgon po/ nyi ma bshes gnyen/ dkon mchog bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs ral gri/ nam mkha' ma byung smon lam/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po/ lha btsun nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ byas 'gyur bsod nams seng ge rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan bkra shis/ mus chen nam mkha' dbang phyug 'jam dbyangs kun dga' legs grub/ byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ grub chen kun dga' rnam rgyal/ mkhyen rab ngag gi dbang phyug drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dang*/ gshin rje'i gshed kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar 'dod khams dbang phyug lha mchog dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis rdo rje'i slob ma 'di rnams kyi 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen tshe dang dpal 'byor snyan grags legs pa'i yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang*/ zhi rgyas dbang drag gi phrin las thams cad thogs med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bhyoḥrakmo sogs kyi mjug tu ma ma sarba karma siddhi ku ru hūm̐ zhes brjod/ gtor ma mgor bzhag de ltar bka' bsgos nas lha mos bka' bsgrub par zhal gyis bzhes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ de rnams kyis rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas de dag gi skabs su thob pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// lan gsum/ rjes gnang zab mo thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal zhig 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod kyang 'bul bas cha shas nas longs spyad du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/

des khyed rang rnams kyis 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor ma'i rjes gnang thun mong ma yin pa legs par thob pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// ces sogs kyis dge ba bsngos/ slob ma rang gnas su btang*/ gsum pa rjes ni/ lha mo la arghaṃ nas/ shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta pū dza hoḥ ma hā rakta pū dza hoḥ zhes sman raka phul/ bcom ldan gshin rje gshed po'i spyan snga ru// zhes sogs kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs bzod par gsol/ tsa ka li la sogs la/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ya swā hā/ zhes me tog gtor/ rten med pa rnams oṃ badzra muḥs ye shes pa gshegs/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ zhes gnas gsum bsrung*/ dge ba bsngo ba dang bkra shis rgyas par bya'o// de ltar 'dod khams dbang phyug dmar zor ma'i// gtor chog rjes gnang cho gar bcas pa rnams// go bde'i ngag gis gsal bar bshad pa'i dges// 'gal rkyen zhi zhing mthun rkyen 'grub par shog /ces 'dod khams dbang phyug dmag zor ma'i thun mong ma yin pa'i rjes gnang bya tshul gsal bar bkod pa bsam 'phel nor bu zhes bya ba 'di yang don gnyer gyi rdo rje slob bu rnams kyi gsung gis bskul ngor/ shākya'i btsun pa kun dga' lhun grub kyis shar chen kun dga' bkra shis kyis mdzad pa'i yi ge las gsal bar bkod pa 'di yang 'phar ba zhes pa lcags glang mchu zla ba phyi ma'i tshes dge bar dben gnas rmor dgon par bris pa'o// brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang*/ paṇḍi ta lwa ba dmar po/ lce 'byung gnas bzang po/ gnubs rgyal ba ye shes/ zhang cog gru shes rab bla ma/ sras saṃ gha bha dra/ sras dpal chen 'od po/ de sras zhang mdo sde rtse mo/ zhang ding ri ba nyi ma grags/ bstan bzang ba rin chen rnam rgyal/ bsam gling pa sangs rgyas 'byung ba/

'jam dbyangs 'khon ston thugs rje rin chen/ byang sems rin chen mgon po/ chos rje nyi ma bshes gnyen/ chos rje dkon mchog dpal bzang po/ rje btsun 'jam dbyangs mgon po/ bo dong ba 'jam dbyangs ral gri/ nam mkha' smon lam/ rje nam mkha'i snying po/ rje nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bya 'gyur ba bsod nams seng ge/ yang dgon pa dpal ldan bkra shis/ sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen/ ngor chen dkon mchog dpal ldan/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ shar pa ye shes bzang po/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs man btsal// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
